explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/959: for A ⊂ ℝ² of size n with distance multiplicities ordered f(d_1) ≥ f(d_2) ≥ ⋯, 'Estimate max (f(d_1) − f(d_2))' over all A of size n. In Lean frequency counts unordered pairs (i < j) at distance d, multiplicityGap P = sup over distances d of f(d) − (largest multiplicity of another distance) (truncated, so this equals f(d_1) − f(d_2), and 0 on ties), Admissible requires n distinct points with at least two distinct distances (so d_2 exists), and extremalGap n is the largest attainable gap (found within the valid range [0, C(n,2)]). The value question asks for answer with extremalGap n = Θ(answer n), the natural reading of 'estimate' (the page records ≫ n log n and a conjectured n^{1+c/log log n}). Faithful.
